project.title: Wall-mounted FIFO dispenser with replaceable wave ornament

coordinate_frame.origin: center of lower rear mounting datum at product bottom

requirements.statement: Five rolls shall move downward by gravity and remain removable from the bottom without contacting ornament.
requirements.verification: full-height clearance body and physical multi-roll test

requirements.statement: The parametric spine shall transfer all product and roll load to the wall.
requirements.verification: load-path review, fastener coupon, and conservative physical test

requirements.statement: The concept-image wave shall be a replaceable decorative body with no critical structural role.
requirements.verification: matched views, assembly/removal test, and keep-out collision

global_style.summary: Japanese-inspired stone body with one large flowing wave and sparse gold-compatible ridges
global_style.detail_hierarchy: outer wave silhouette, three foam curls, broad ridges, no microtexture

assembly_sequence: Install structural modules and verify the exact roll-path clearance body.
Fuse or fasten the parametric backer to the spine outside the roll path.
Insert the wave ornament into the keyed backer.
Load five rolls from the top and perform repeated bottom-removal tests.

decision_log.topic: Approve the concept image, wave mask, and isolated generation plates.
decision_log.current_basis: The example references IMG-WALL-001 but does not ship that image.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable source, evidence crop, mask, and approved component-only plates.

decision_log.topic: Select mounting hardware for the actual wall substrate and service load.
decision_log.current_basis: The example mounting envelope is illustrative.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Substrate identification, purchased hardware data, installed load case, and proof test.

components.name: Parametric structural FIFO spine
components.role: wall mounting, roll guidance, module interfaces, and structural authority

manufacturing.orientation: module-specific, structural rails aligned with extrusion paths

components.name: Curved parametric wave backer
components.role: exact seat, keys, and load spreader outside the roll path

components.name: Replaceable sculptural wave
components.role: organic visual identity and customer-selectable decorative body

manufacturing.orientation: choose for visible crest and thick root; support kept off hero face

image_to_3d.positive_prompt: One coherent stylized breaking ocean wave, broad carved ridges, three large foam curls, a clear open central curl, thick quiet rear root for later trimming, matte neutral clay, printable medium-scale forms.
negative_spaces: central curl opening remains connected and no smaller than the process-tested gap

landmarks.meaning: rear silhouette extremum in the lateral view

requirements.load_or_flow: retention and handling, no primary load

keepouts.purpose: coarse central proxy only; exact swept cylinder and exit path live in CAD
keepouts.source: 122 mm roll clearance body plus motion allowance

validation.acceptance: single authority per interface and no structural dependence on ornament

validation.method: assemble spine, roll swept body, backer, and ornament envelopes
validation.acceptance: assembly and five-roll path remain clear

validation.method: mesh intake and matched clay views
validation.acceptance: identity, envelope, open curl, root, and topology pass

validation.method: sections, intersection/gap, wall, and surface-preservation checks
slice all bodies with the named profile
validation.acceptance: expected walls, no trapped support, and separate color bodies

validation.method: key coupon, two-module FIFO test, then full tower
validation.acceptance: repeatable insertion/removal and gravity feed without jams
